review:
Big Bass Halloween Splash 1000 is a spooky take on the Big Bass formula, with fish money symbols now worth up to 1,000x. Three, four or five scatters award 10, 15 or 20 free spins, and with only two scatters there is a random chance more are added to trigger the round.

Before the bonus you pick from six pumpkins to reveal up to five modifiers: extra wilds, money symbols or spins, starting at the second multiplier level, or a better chance of random features. In free spins the fisherman wild collects every fish on screen. Every fourth wild adds 10 spins and raises the win multiplier to 2x, 3x and finally 10x. Pumpkins on reel five can add more upgrades. Published RTP is 96.50%. For fans of the series.
